  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]

  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.

  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Advanced Sensor Solutions
# Sales, Design and Manufacture


AV Sensors is an engineering company focused on the design, manufacture and sales of silicon
pressure sensors, transmitters, and transducers for the medical, industrial and consumer market. 
Our focus is to deliver high quality derivative based custom pressure sensors with minimal
development cost.  We can replicate most any MEMS pressure sensor with quick delivery.  We pride
ourselves having excellent service and have US based technical professionals that are the single
point of contact for all your needs.  AV Sensors is the antithesis of multinational companies that
now dominate the sensor space.

[Have a Question?][39]
[Need a Custom Product?][40]

# Contact an Advanced Sensors technical professional who will respond to your question within 24
# hours. 

[Have a Prouct that is Obsoleted][41]
[ or Discontinued?][42]

# AV Sensors have many products that replace discontinued pressure sensors from Amphenol, Nova
# Sensor, TE Connectivity, Measurement Specialties, Silicon Microstructures and Honeywell.

[Cross Now][43]
[Design Services][44]

AV Sensors restores low cost solutions with the confidence and ability to produce any pressure
sensor design on plastic, FR4, and ceramic substrates. 
 
Tell us about your need for a sensor solution.  We guarantee a response within 24 hrs.

## Explore by Sensor Type

[Board Mount][45]

AV Sensors has a large selection of board mount sensor products. Whether digital output, high level
analog, mV output compensated, or low cost uncompensated sensors; AV Sensors have the solution for
any product application or market. 

[[Board Mount Sensor]][46]
[High Accuracy][47]

AV Sensors offers glass bonded gage, epoxy bonded, and oil isolated technologies for industrial
transmitter products.  Married with the next generation of Mixed Signal ASICS these sensors support,
24 bit digital, ratiometric analog output, and traditional 4-20mA outputs.  

[[Oil Filled Sensor, Ribbon Cable]][48]
[Oil Isolated Industrial][49]
[Rugged Industrial][50]

AV Sensors  glass bonded gage industrial transducers  are are designed to measure pressure, flow and
temperature of corrosive and ionic gases used in compressors, refrigeration or process control
instrumentation.  With a one piece port construction and silicon gages bonded to a machined
diaphragm these sensors offer the highest protection again corrosive environments.  

[[MIMCT-7A Pressure Sensor]][51]
[Disposable Medical Sensors][52]

AV Sensors  Disposable  Medical Pressure Transducer contain a piezo resistive sensor element that
delivers a high level  mV output in a low cost, small footprint, leadless castellation package  that
can be used in single use medical applications. The sensors is designed and calibrated per the
Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation (AAMI BP-22 Standard) guidelines. 

[[AAMI Specification]][53]
[Air Flow Sensors][54]

AV Sensors   has designed these Mass Air Flow Sensors from the ground up, incorporating the latest
MEMS and microelectronics innovations. The sensor die uses a pair of thermopiles to detect changes
in temperature caused by mass flow, delivering ultra-low noise and unsurpassed repeatability.

[[AWM 7 Mass Air Flow Sensor]][55]
[Cross Reference][56]

AV Sensors have many  sensors that are pin for pin compatible to those offered by Amphenol, Nova
Sensor, TE Connectivity, Measurement Specialties, Silicon Microstructures and Honeywell.  If you are
looking for improved pricing, delivery, or access to development engineers, this is you starting
point.  

[[Cross Reference, Products]][57]

and surgical instrumentation.  Their design construction use the highest resolution ASICs, the

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Carista?

Carista is a mobile App used with a Carista OBD2 Scanner that empowers drivers to diagnose dashboard
warning lights, customize vehicle settings, perform essential car service, and monitor live data. It
provides brand-specific, dealer-level features for supported vehicles in a simple, user-friendly
package.

Can you use Carista for free?

Yes. Carista gives you free access to essential features, including reading and clearing standard
OBD2 fault codes, live OBD2 data, emissions tests readiness to see whether your car is likely to
pass an emissions inspection, detailed ECU information, and tools like the acceleration test. You
can use these features by simply connecting your car to an OBD2 adapter. Advanced diagnostics,
manufacturer-specific codes, and vehicle customizations require a paid subscription (monthly or
yearly).

Can you clear codes with Carista?

Yes, you can clear fault codes with Carista.

You scan your vehicle’s systems like Engine, ABS, SRS/Airbag, Transmission, TPMS, and other
electronic units directly from the App. After reviewing the diagnostic results, you can clear the
codes and reset warning lights. This allows you to verify repairs and monitor whether a fault
returns.

What cars does Carista work on?

Carista works with a wide range of car brands and supports many models within each one. The features
you can use depend on your vehicle’s make, model, and year.

Supported brands include: Audi, BMW, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Cupra, Dacia, Ford, Genesis, GMC,
Holden, Hyundai, Infiniti, Jaguar, Kia, Land Rover, Lexus, Lincoln, MAN, Mazda, MINI, Nissan,
Opel/Vauxhall, Pontiac, Renault, Saab, Scion, SEAT, Škoda, Toyota, Volkswagen, and Volvo.

How does Carista work?

Simply plug the Carista OBD2 Scanner into your vehicle’s OBD2 port, connect to the Carista App via
Bluetooth, and access diagnostics, live data, service tools, and customizations. Advanced features
require a subscription.

## Global Responsibility.

Founded in 2007, Disposafe Health and Life Care Limited has grown into a globally trusted
manufacturer of disposable medical devices, serving healthcare systems in 130+ countries with over
600 million devices produced annually.

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities operate under rigorous quality standards: 11,400+ QC
checkpoints, 650+ manufacturing checklists, ensuring every device meets the highest clinical
expectations.

**Safety**Patient-first in every design
**Precision**Engineered to exact tolerances
**Compliance**ISO, CE, FDA, MDSAP, TGA
**Innovation**Continuous R&D since 2012
[Learn More →][23]

Zero compromise

## How We Eliminate Risk.

Every Disposafe product passes through multiple layers of quality assurance from raw material
inspection to final device release.

#### 11,400+ QC Checkpoints

Every batch passes through rigorous multi-stage quality control from raw material inspection through
finished-device release.

#### 650+ Manufacturing Checklists

Standardised process checklists govern every production step, eliminating variability and ensuring
batch-to-batch consistency.

#### Redundant QC Verification

Dual-layer quality verification with AI-assisted machine-vision inspection and in-house EO
sterilization validation for every product line.

## Precision Manufacturing.
## Global Responsibility.

Founded in 2007, Disposafe Health and Life Care Limited has grown into a globally trusted
manufacturer of disposable medical devices, serving healthcare systems in 130+ countries with over
600 million devices produced annually.

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities operate under rigorous quality standards: 11,400+ QC
checkpoints, 650+ manufacturing checklists, ensuring every device meets the highest clinical
expectations.

**Safety**Patient-first in every design
**Precision**Engineered to exact tolerances
**Compliance**ISO, CE, FDA, MDSAP, TGA
**Innovation**Continuous R&D since 2012
[Learn More →][23]

Zero compromise

## How We Eliminate Risk.

Every Disposafe product passes through multiple layers of quality assurance from raw material
inspection to final device release.

#### 11,400+ QC Checkpoints

Every batch passes through rigorous multi-stage quality control from raw material inspection through
finished-device release.

#### 650+ Manufacturing Checklists

Standardised process checklists govern every production step, eliminating variability and ensuring
batch-to-batch consistency.

#### Redundant QC Verification

Dual-layer quality verification with AI-assisted machine-vision inspection and in-house EO
sterilization validation for every product line.

## Ready to Partner With Us?

Talk to our team about your requirements, regulatory needs, or OEM / private-label opportunities.

### [2026 Nasal & Inhalation Drug Development & Delivery eBook: Drug Repurposing Creates New Market
### Opportunities][16]

In this exclusive seventh annual nasal and inhalation eBook, Drug Development & Delivery highlights
how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

* [Thermistors NTC/PTC/LPTC/PPTC][171]
  Thermistor as a thermal sensitive passive component it shows negative or positive resistance
  effect with changing of subject temperature.  With its predictable and accuracy sensing
  performance,  it is widely used in circuit performing as measurement control or protect functions
* [Level/Temp/Reed Switch Sensor][172]
  With the interaction between matching parameter reed and magnet, Focusens design and produce
  proximate switch as both vertical and horizontal types. Our switch sensor give control liquid
  level,proximate position with combination of temperature control as electrical switch for
  extensive applications.
* [Temperature Sensor][173]
  Focusens concentrate on components solution for temperature, humidity, level and position sensing
  and control.  We design develop and produce sensors for 5 major applications : Household,
  automobile both fueled and EV energy,medical, IoT and industry Our sensor covers full line of
  thermistors,PT RTDs, Thermocouples,as well as Digital types like DS18B20 ,LM35 ,TMP117, DS2431
  etc.for temperature sensing. We also flexible custom humidity and reed base magnetic level and
  position switch sensors for extensitive application conditions. 
* [Thermal Fuse/Thermal Protector][174]
  Thermal Fuse or TCO thermal cut off are non-resettable electronic compontent, it will melt or
  broke out when circuit is over hot. The thermal protector however is auto or manually resetable
  protective devices cutting or connecting circuit under desired conditions.
* [Temperature/Humidity Transmitter][175]
  We Adopt Standard Manufacturing Management.  Quality Control According to ISO 9001:2015 System and
  On site Management Strictly Conducted Under 6S System.  All our products are ROHS and REACH
  compliance.
* [Cable Assembly/Wire Harness][176]
  In line with our temperature probes application, Focusens customize cable harness or wire assembly
  for line of Home Applications like white goods and black goods, Automobiles especially EV car or
  BMS , Medicals,Iot , and Industry Machines .

* [Level/Temp/Reed Switch Sensor][172]
  With the interaction between matching parameter reed and magnet, Focusens design and produce
  proximate switch as both vertical and horizontal types. Our switch sensor give control liquid
  level,proximate position with combination of temperature control as electrical switch for
  extensive applications.
* [Temperature Sensor][173]
  Focusens concentrate on components solution for temperature, humidity, level and position sensing
  and control.  We design develop and produce sensors for 5 major applications : Household,
  automobile both fueled and EV energy,medical, IoT and industry Our sensor covers full line of
  thermistors,PT RTDs, Thermocouples,as well as Digital types like DS18B20 ,LM35 ,TMP117, DS2431
  etc.for temperature sensing. We also flexible custom humidity and reed base magnetic level and
  position switch sensors for extensitive application conditions. 
* [Thermal Fuse/Thermal Protector][174]
  Thermal Fuse or TCO thermal cut off are non-resettable electronic compontent, it will melt or
  broke out when circuit is over hot. The thermal protector however is auto or manually resetable
  protective devices cutting or connecting circuit under desired conditions.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

# IMS

Semiconductor-based, AI-powered, Personal Health Monitoring for Everyone
Monitoring multiple health markers using ONE device

Our flagship product: an AI-powered miniature sensor for continuous diabetes monitoring, generating
real-time, intelligent insights for patients and caregivers.

### Semiconductor

Custom microchips with the power of modern semiconductor technology to make sensing, communication,
and digital processing easier than ever before.

### AI

AI for real-time glucose analysis, predictive alerts, and personalized patterns.

### Nanotechnology

Ability to get more data from a smaller device.

### Wireless

Small wearable form factor with wireless real-time data to your smartphones.

## Technology

AI-Powered Multi-modal Sensing Technology

### Custom Semiconductors

Custom chips designed for the specific problem, to optimize user experience and performance at a
lower cost than others.

### AI Intelligence Engine

The brain behind smarter sensing: Continuously learning your patterns and providing insights.

### Nano-Scale Sensors

Maximizing the performance of miniaturized sensors.

### Integrated Architecture

Semiconductor, nano sensors, and AI in one platform to serve the user needs in a way never possible
before.

## Features

AI-First Technology

Why IMS?

Simple, accurate, painless, **miniature sensors**, powered by custom semiconductors, specialized
nanotech, and personalized AI.

[IMS miniature sensor shown next to a coin for scale]

Sensor scale reference

### On-Chip Digital Processing Decision Making

Processing and decisions happen on-device for speed, privacy, and reliability.

### AI-Powered Analytics

Personalized insights and real-time decision support powered by AI.

### Fully-integrated Microsystem

On-chip sensors, control circuit, digitizer, processor, communication circuit, and power management.

### Scalable Manufacturing

The advantage of the scalability of semiconductor manufacturing for health monitoring.

## About

Pioneering simple, accurate, painless health monitoring with a miniature microsensor.

First Product: Miniature Multi-Sensor system for monitoring diabetes, named as CGM+.

It is a single wearable device that measures multiple key parameters, enabling users to take control
of their metabolic health.

### Our Story

Our founders are motivated by their personal connections to diabetes. Having family members with
diabetes connected them together to solve the issue of continuous stress due to the unknown status
of the disease. They want to remove anxiety from diabetes management.

The founders earned their PhDs in sensor technology and teamed up with experts in sensors and AI to
develop a product. They recognized the need for intelligent sensors that could process data from
multiple sources to generate reliable, actionable insights into a user's health.

The microsensors developed in the process enable intelligent sensing from wearables to diagnostics.

[IMS wearable device]

#### Our Values

Users First
Pushing the boundaries of what's possible
Sustainable
Performance with minimal environmental impact
Open Collaboration
Partners to accelerate adoption

## Contact

Get In Touch

Let's discuss how IMS can solve your challenges.

AI for real-time glucose analysis, predictive alerts, and personalized patterns.

### Nanotechnology

Ability to get more data from a smaller device.

### Wireless

Small wearable form factor with wireless real-time data to your smartphones.

## Technology

AI-Powered Multi-modal Sensing Technology

### Custom Semiconductors

Custom chips designed for the specific problem, to optimize user experience and performance at a
lower cost than others.

### AI Intelligence Engine

The brain behind smarter sensing: Continuously learning your patterns and providing insights.

### Nano-Scale Sensors

Maximizing the performance of miniaturized sensors.

### Integrated Architecture

Semiconductor, nano sensors, and AI in one platform to serve the user needs in a way never possible
before.

## Features

AI-First Technology

Why IMS?

Simple, accurate, painless, **miniature sensors**, powered by custom semiconductors, specialized
nanotech, and personalized AI.

[IMS miniature sensor shown next to a coin for scale]

Sensor scale reference

### On-Chip Digital Processing Decision Making

Processing and decisions happen on-device for speed, privacy, and reliability.

### AI-Powered Analytics

Personalized insights and real-time decision support powered by AI.

### Fully-integrated Microsystem

On-chip sensors, control circuit, digitizer, processor, communication circuit, and power management.

### Scalable Manufacturing

The advantage of the scalability of semiconductor manufacturing for health monitoring.

## About

Pioneering simple, accurate, painless health monitoring with a miniature microsensor.

First Product: Miniature Multi-Sensor system for monitoring diabetes, named as CGM+.

It is a single wearable device that measures multiple key parameters, enabling users to take control
of their metabolic health.

### Our Story

Our founders are motivated by their personal connections to diabetes. Having family members with
diabetes connected them together to solve the issue of continuous stress due to the unknown status
of the disease. They want to remove anxiety from diabetes management.

The founders earned their PhDs in sensor technology and teamed up with experts in sensors and AI to
develop a product. They recognized the need for intelligent sensors that could process data from
multiple sources to generate reliable, actionable insights into a user's health.

The microsensors developed in the process enable intelligent sensing from wearables to diagnostics.

[IMS wearable device]

Users First
Pushing the boundaries of what's possible
Sustainable
Performance with minimal environmental impact
Open Collaboration
Partners to accelerate adoption

#### What happens if my component is backordered?

[**ABOUT**][58][** **][59][**US**][60]

Medical Sensors India Pvt. Ltd., is a company that specializes in Medical Accessories and Traffic
Safety products. We are operating since June 2004.

Our journey started with offering customized accessories for Medical Equipment manufacturers ( Pulse
Oxi meters, ICU Ventilators and Oxygen Monitors) and branched into the fabrication of Hi-Tech
Ambulances as we had the domain expertise from our earlier associations/engagements. Gradually we
branched out to Traffic Safety and built Traffic Interceptors for AP Transport Dept and Karnataka
Transport Dept. Based on the successful performance at these agencies, we were asked to provide
similar solutions to various police forces all over India.

With time, we started assembling Laser cameras, Breath Analysers locally with key components
imported from Europe, USA and China. Today we have over 75% localization of these products. Not only
do we have considerable market share in India but also in SAARC countries and parts of Africa.

We also share a memorable bond with Honeywell India with whom we partnered and provided critical
medical spares for Ventilator manufacturers during the COVID-19 pandemic and did our small service
to the PM CARES initiatives.

Our success story largely is due to the dedicated team members and channel partners who have stood
by us over the years. After sales support is what brings customers back to us year after year.



[**Contact us:**][61]

Medical Sensors India Pvt. Ltd. has sales and service teams in Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad,
Bhubaneswar, New Delhi, Cochin, Jammu, and Goa.

[**ABOUT**][58][** **][59][**US**][60]

Medical Sensors India Pvt. Ltd., is a company that specializes in Medical Accessories and Traffic
Safety products. We are operating since June 2004.

Our journey started with offering customized accessories for Medical Equipment manufacturers ( Pulse
Oxi meters, ICU Ventilators and Oxygen Monitors) and branched into the fabrication of Hi-Tech
Ambulances as we had the domain expertise from our earlier associations/engagements. Gradually we
branched out to Traffic Safety and built Traffic Interceptors for AP Transport Dept and Karnataka
Transport Dept. Based on the successful performance at these agencies, we were asked to provide
similar solutions to various police forces all over India.

With time, we started assembling Laser cameras, Breath Analysers locally with key components
imported from Europe, USA and China. Today we have over 75% localization of these products. Not only
do we have considerable market share in India but also in SAARC countries and parts of Africa.

We also share a memorable bond with Honeywell India with whom we partnered and provided critical
medical spares for Ventilator manufacturers during the COVID-19 pandemic and did our small service
to the PM CARES initiatives.

Our success story largely is due to the dedicated team members and channel partners who have stood
by us over the years. After sales support is what brings customers back to us year after year.



[**Contact us:**][61]

Medical Sensors India Pvt. Ltd. has sales and service teams in Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad,
Bhubaneswar, New Delhi, Cochin, Jammu, and Goa.

  ## Rosicrucianism
  
  ### Inside the Secret Society Shaping Occult Thought
  
  Rosicrucianism mixes Hermeticism, alchemy, Kabbalah, Christian mysticism and esoteric symbolism
  into a secret society that shaped Renaissance and Enlightenment thought. Born from early
  17th‑century manifestos and the legend of Christian Rosenkreuz, the tradition teaches inner
  transformation through ritual, initiation, symbolic art, meditation, and study of occult sciences
  like astrology and spiritual healing. Rosicrucian orders preserved hidden knowledge, influenced
  Freemasonry, magic, and modern occult movements, and debated science and faith. This guide
  explores origins, teachings, symbols (rose and cross), practices, key figures, controversies, and
  the movement’s legacy in modern esotericism.
  OccultRebeccaJul 24, 2026][31]
* [
  
  ## Book of Shadows
  
  ### Wicca’s Secret Grimoire and Its Magical Power
  
  A secret grimoire born from Wiccan practice holds ritual texts, spells, herbal lore, and
  ceremonial instructions that shape modern witchcraft and occult study. Coven members and solitary
  practitioners draw on its pages for circle casting, initiation rites, moon magic, divination,
  protection charms, and ethical guidelines, blending folk magic with ceremonial techniques. Tracing
  roots through folklore, the 20th‑century revival, and figures like Gerald Gardner and Doreen
  Valiente, this living manuscript influences neopaganism, spellcraft, and contemporary occult
  tradition.
  OccultRebeccaJul 23, 2026][32]
* [
  
  ## Protein Folding Problem
  
  ### The Puzzle at the Center of Biology
  
  Scientists face a hard question: how does a chain of amino acids fold so quickly into a precise 3D
  shape, the native conformation? This sequence-to-structure mystery — shaped by thermodynamics,
  folding pathways, kinetics and Levinthal’s paradox — controls enzyme action, cell signaling and
  misfolding diseases. Predicting structure from sequence is the core challenge in computational
  biology, where machine learning breakthroughs, AlphaFold, and experimental tools like X-ray
  crystallography, cryo-EM and NMR aim to crack the folding code for better drug design and
  understanding of protein function.
  RiddleCharlesJul 22, 2026][33]
* [
  
  ## Homunculus Fallacy
  
  ### The Infinite Regress of the Mind's Eye
  
  A tiny inner observer that watches thoughts and perceptions sounds like a tidy explanation, but it
  triggers an infinite regress: each watcher would need its own mind's eye, and that eye would need
  another watcher, and so on. This philosophical snag exposes weak models of cognition,
  consciousness, perception and representation, and invites clearer accounts from neuroscience,
  psychology and computational theory. The regress problem and its recursion show why mere appeals
  to an inner observer or little thinker fail as genuine explanations of thinking and mental
  representation.
  RiddleCharlesJul 21, 2026][34]
* [
  
  ## Knockings at Borley Rectory
  
  ### Britain’s Most Haunted House and Its Ghostly Phenomena
  
  Borley Rectory became a focal point of ghost stories after years of loud knockings, moving stones,
  unexplained footsteps and sightings of a phantom nun. The Victorian rectory drew spiritualists,
  curious locals and investigators such as Harry Price, while the rector’s family—most famously
  Marianne Foyster—reported doors opening, strange lights, inked messages and poltergeist activity.
  The mix of apparitions, séances, physical phenomena and fierce debate about truth and fraud turned
  this Essex house into a lasting chapter of supernatural lore.
  OccultRebeccaJul 20, 2026][35]

  triggers an infinite regress: each watcher would need its own mind's eye, and that eye would need
  another watcher, and so on. This philosophical snag exposes weak models of cognition,
  consciousness, perception and representation, and invites clearer accounts from neuroscience,

  to an inner observer or little thinker fail as genuine explanations of thinking and mental

  Borley Rectory became a focal point of ghost stories after years of loud knockings, moving stones,
  unexplained footsteps and sightings of a phantom nun. The Victorian rectory drew spiritualists,
  curious locals and investigators such as Harry Price, while the rector’s family—most famously
  Marianne Foyster—reported doors opening, strange lights, inked messages and poltergeist activity.
  The mix of apparitions, séances, physical phenomena and fierce debate about truth and fraud turned
  this Essex house into a lasting chapter of supernatural lore.

  ### California’s Phantom Galleon
  
  A long-running hunt in California centers on a lost ship buried in the Colorado Desert—an eerie
  phantom galleon resting under miles of sand and carrying gold, silver, artifacts and secret maps.
  Treasure hunters, explorers and amateur archaeologists follow old charts, oral tales and strange
  ground anomalies, convinced the buried shipwreck will rewrite local history. Satellite scans,
  desert camps and ghost-ship stories fuel a race to uncover the galleon, unlock its cargo and
  reveal the mystery beneath the sand.

  ## Lost City of Z
  
  ### Uncovering the Amazon's Greatest Mystery
  
  Deep in the Amazon rainforest a century-old mystery pulled explorers into the jungle and left many
  missing without a trace. Percy Fawcett's 1920s expeditions into Mato Grosso and the Xingu, broken
  maps, indigenous testimony, mysterious geoglyphs and rumors of a fabled golden city drove
  archaeologists, treasure hunters and modern researchers to chase ruins, lost campsites, secret
  trails and vanished parties beneath the choking canopy.

* [
  
  ## Prime Number Distribution
  
  ### Why Are Primes So Mysteriously Scattered?
  
  Primes behave like scattered jewels on the number line: they get rarer as numbers grow, yet hidden
  patterns and surprising gaps keep mathematicians guessing. The prime counting function pi(x), the
  Prime Number Theorem and the logarithmic integral li(x) give big-picture rules for prime density,
  while prime gaps, twin primes and the Riemann Hypothesis probe deep, unresolved structure. Tools
  such as the sieve of Eratosthenes, probabilistic models and large-scale computation reveal both
  order and apparent randomness. Cryptographers rely on the scarcity and unpredictability of large
  primes to secure digital communication, so understanding distribution is both a pure math mystery
  and a real-world necessity.

  ## Quantum Computing and Cryptography
  
  ### Can Quantum Machines Crack All Codes?

  to run Shor’s algorithm, which can break common public-key systems like RSA and ECC, while

  that not all encryption is instantly broken—symmetric keys can be strengthened, and post-quantum
  cryptography (lattice-based, code-based, hash-based and multivariate schemes) plus
  quantum-resistant digital signatures offer practical defenses. The piece also covers timelines,
  threat models, migration strategies, hybrid designs, and steps for key management so organizations
  can prepare for a quantum-safe future.

  coast of Ireland, sending the passenger ship to the bottom of the Atlantic and killing nearly
  1,200 people. The catastrophe exposed the deadly reach of unrestricted submarine warfare,
  electrified naval and diplomatic debate, inflamed public opinion in Britain and the United States,
  and helped turn the sinking into a crucial moment in World War I.

  ## Atlantis of the Sands
  
  ### The Search for Ubar
  
  Legends speak of a vanished desert metropolis called Ubar or Iram, once wealthy from frankincense,
  caravan trade, and ancient riches carried across the Rub' al Khali. Scholars, Bedouin guides, and
  satellite archaeology follow dune lines, dried riverbeds, oases and sinkholes, hunting ruins,
  wells, and ruined fortifications. The hunt mixes myth, treasure, and field science as explorers
  probe the Empty Quarter for traces of a lost city that could reshape what is known about Arabia's
  past.

  sentence that combined drawing (being dragged to the scaffold), hanging, disembowelment, beheading

  treason, it became a public spectacle and legal ritual: the condemned were drawn and hanged, often

  terrorized New York in the 1920s and 1930s. His crimes involved kidnapping, torture, brutal

  10-year-old Grace Budd. Fish confessed to numerous other killings and described acts of

  Tiny, ultra-dense threads of warped spacetime might thread the universe: cosmic strings,

  one-dimensional objects would pack huge energy density, create gravitational waves and unique
  gravitational lensing, and leave traces in the cosmic microwave background and pulsar
  timing—offering a rare probe of inflation, particle physics, and the topology of spacetime.
  RiddleCharle

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

### Contract Manufacturing

## Complex Medical Products From Concept Through Completion

Efficiency. Scalability. Risk reduction. Our history of excellence and speed to market in contract
medical manufacturing is based on obsessive attention to these factors at every stage of your
project. Combining in-house engineering, injection molding and assembly expertise with our global
supply chain, we partner with you from device design through distribution and from prototype through
commercialization. All manufacturing facilities are FDA-registered and ISO 13485-certified.

For over 35 years, SMC has successfully helped leading medtech diagnostic & pharmaceutical companies
achieve their goals. We’ve built our business around aligning the right experts with the right phase
of every project. Our capabilities go unmatched.

### Pharma Services

## Expanded Solutions to Serve Our Pharmaceutical Customers

SMC Pharma Services provides end-to-end capabilities for our valued pharma partners. We offer drug
delivery platform technologies as well as pharmaceutical services from early-stage development and
analytical services to sterile fill finish, commercial manufacturing and complete packaging
solutions.

### Development Services

Working with SMC at an early stage in the development lifecycle mitigates the cost, time and risk
associated with typical tech transfers.

### Analytical Services

From intricate surgical tools to advanced biopsy and injection devices, we deliver custom solutions
with precision, ensuring seamless production and expedited delivery for single-use medical devices.

## Four Things You Must Know

What We Do

[SSI Electronics][80] is an industry-leading designer and manufacturer of custom human-machine
interfaces and medical circuits. (aka: membrane switches, [rubber keypads][81], [flexible
circuits][82], graphic overlays and disposable medical circuits).

Who We Serve

We serve over 300 companies in 15 different industries.

What We Do Best

SSI listens to the wants and needs of our customers. From there, we work tirelessly to meet or
exceed their requirements by [providing reliable products][83] at globally competitive pricing.

Where We Are Located

SSI is headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan with additional manufacturing facilities overseas.
SSI has local representation in 15 cities throughout the US.

### Custom Products and Outstanding Customer Support

At SSI, we support our customers through every stage of the product realization process, from design
to finished product. We also understand that providing quality products to our customers is
paramount to their overall success.  SSI considers it a privilege to be a key supplier of HMI
products to a wide‐ranging customer base, and we serve businesses of every size, from large medical
OEMs, to small start‐ups and everything in between.

Companies turn to [SSI Electronics][84] for their custom products when it matters the most.

[Products][85]
[man using computer]

### About SSI Electronics

[SSI Electronics][86] is an industry-leading designer and manufacturer of custom components and
products for a wide range of applications and industries. SSI’s core products are typically used to
enable humans to interact with electronic devices. These “human-machine interfaces” come in the form
of membrane switches, [rubber keypads][87], touch screens, [flexible circuits][88], and a variety of
other technologies.

Additionally, we are experts in the manufacturing of custom circuits, electrodes, and sensors
utilized within the medical industry. These circuits are often disposable and are used for
diagnosing and/or monitoring numerous types of biological and medical conditions.

# Why Choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre?

It begins with a question—a doubt, a discomfort, a concern that brings you searching for clarity. At
that moment, when health feels uncertain, what one needs most is reassurance—the quiet confidence
that someone will handle your concern with care, the certainty that the answers you seek will come
with both precision and thoughtfulness.

## Built on Trust, Backed by Expertise

Since our inception in 1981, we have remained true to one simple promise—diagnostics with a human
touch. From a modest beginning, we have grown into one of India’s most respected diagnostic
networks. We have achieved this feat by providing top-quality diagnostic care and earning the trust
of numerous customers across the country.

Our team today is made up of over 3000 dedicated professionals, including 300+ of India’s leading
specialised and super-specialised radiologists and pathologists. Along with their deep expertise and
technical skills, they bring empathy, compassion, and a strong commitment to patient care.

Every test we conduct is handled with precision and responsibility—because we understand that your
medical reports aren’t just numbers, they’re the foundation of your peace of mind.

We also offer a wide range of [health packages][139] curated for every age group and lifestyle,
ensuring preventive care is accessible and personalised. Understanding that healthcare is not just
about treatment but also about prevention, we have curated a comprehensive suite of preventive
health check-up packages tailored to diverse age groups, health conditions, and lifestyles.

## Accessible Care, Thoughtfully Delivered

Today, Vijaya is present in 6 states, across 25 cities with over [160 centres][140]. Each one of
these centres carries the same hallmark of care. Our centres are spread over multiple locations
across 25+ cities, which means there’s a Vijaya diagnostic centre near you whenever you want
effective diagnostic care. No matter which centre you visit, our philosophy remains unchanged:
offering patients consistent quality, accessible service, and unwavering integrity.

For those who cannot come to us because of health issues, age, or tight schedules, we come to them.
Our [home sample collection][141] service is not just a convenience—it’s a commitment to ensuring
that no one is left behind and care reaches the doorstep of those who need it the most.

## A Quiet Presence in Life’s Important Moments

Every day, people walk into our centres with concerns they may not always say out loud. Some come
alone; some are accompanied by loved ones. Some are looking for answers. Others simply want
reassurance. And in these quiet, crucial moments, we stand beside them, not just as professionals,
but as trusted partners in their journey towards better health.

## Numbers That Speak of Trust, Not Just Growth

Over the last 40+ years, Vijaya has quietly built a legacy rooted in both care and credibility. Our
strength lies in our people—3000+ skilled professionals, including 300+ specialised and super
specialised radiologists and pathologists who bring experience and empathy to their work. We’ve had
the privilege of serving 100+ million individuals, and we are trusted by 450+ organisations across
the country.

## Uncompromising on Quality and Accreditation

Quality is at the heart of Vijaya Diagnostic Centre’s operations—it’s a culture that’s ingrained in
our practices and deep-rooted in our professional approaches. Every process is governed by globally
recognised standards, ensuring your health is always the top priority. Our diagnostic laboratories
are accredited by NABL, our flagship centre is certified under ISO 9001:2015, and our operations
align with NABH protocols to ensure clinical excellence and patient safety.

## Because You Deserve Nothing Less

When you choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, you are choosing care that is personal, not transactional.
You are choosing an experience grounded in science and service rooted in empathy. You are choosing a
place where every step—from booking a diagnostic test to reporting—is designed around your comfort.

At every [diagnostic centre][142] under our network, the focus remains the same: accurate diagnosis,
timely reporting, seamless experience, and compassionate communication.

Most importantly, you are choosing a team that understands that behind every test lies a person—a
life, a story, and a hope. And that’s a responsibility we carry with pride.

# Why Choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre?

It begins with a question—a doubt, a discomfort, a concern that brings you searching for clarity. At
that moment, when health feels uncertain, what one needs most is reassurance—the quiet confidence
that someone will handle your concern with care, the certainty that the answers you seek will come
with both precision and thoughtfulness.

## Built on Trust, Backed by Expertise

Since our inception in 1981, we have remained true to one simple promise—diagnostics with a human
touch. From a modest beginning, we have grown into one of India’s most respected diagnostic
networks. We have achieved this feat by providing top-quality diagnostic care and earning the trust
of numerous customers across the country.

Our team today is made up of over 3000 dedicated professionals, including 300+ of India’s leading
specialised and super-specialised radiologists and pathologists. Along with their deep expertise and
technical skills, they bring empathy, compassion, and a strong commitment to patient care.

Every test we conduct is handled with precision and responsibility—because we understand that your
medical reports aren’t just numbers, they’re the foundation of your peace of mind.

We also offer a wide range of [health packages][139] curated for every age group and lifestyle,
ensuring preventive care is accessible and personalised. Understanding that healthcare is not just
about treatment but also about prevention, we have curated a comprehensive suite of preventive
health check-up packages tailored to diverse age groups, health conditions, and lifestyles.

## Accessible Care, Thoughtfully Delivered

Today, Vijaya is present in 6 states, across 25 cities with over [160 centres][140]. Each one of
these centres carries the same hallmark of care. Our centres are spread over multiple locations
across 25+ cities, which means there’s a Vijaya diagnostic centre near you whenever you want
effective diagnostic care. No matter which centre you visit, our philosophy remains unchanged:
offering patients consistent quality, accessible service, and unwavering integrity.

For those who cannot come to us because of health issues, age, or tight schedules, we come to them.
Our [home sample collection][141] service is not just a convenience—it’s a commitment to ensuring
that no one is left behind and care reaches the doorstep of those who need it the most.

## A Quiet Presence in Life’s Important Moments

Every day, people walk into our centres with concerns they may not always say out loud. Some come
alone; some are accompanied by loved ones. Some are looking for answers. Others simply want
reassurance. And in these quiet, crucial moments, we stand beside them, not just as professionals,
but as trusted partners in their journey towards better health.

## Numbers That Speak of Trust, Not Just Growth

Over the last 40+ years, Vijaya has quietly built a legacy rooted in both care and credibility. Our
strength lies in our people—3000+ skilled professionals, including 300+ specialised and super
specialised radiologists and pathologists who bring experience and empathy to their work. We’ve had
the privilege of serving 100+ million individuals, and we are trusted by 450+ organisations across
the country.

## Uncompromising on Quality and Accreditation

Quality is at the heart of Vijaya Diagnostic Centre’s operations—it’s a culture that’s ingrained in
our practices and deep-rooted in our professional approaches. Every process is governed by globally
recognised standards, ensuring your health is always the top priority. Our diagnostic laboratories
are accredited by NABL, our flagship centre is certified under ISO 9001:2015, and our operations
align with NABH protocols to ensure clinical excellence and patient safety.

## Because You Deserve Nothing Less

When you choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, you are choosing care that is personal, not transactional.
You are choosing an experience grounded in science and service rooted in empathy. You are choosing a
place where every step—from booking a diagnostic test to reporting—is designed around your comfort.

At every [diagnostic centre][142] under our network, the focus remains the same: accurate diagnosis,
timely reporting, seamless experience, and compassionate communication.

Most importantly, you are choosing a team that understands that behind every test lies a person—a
life, a story, and a hope. And that’s a responsibility we carry with pride.

## Trust Vijaya for Advanced Medical Care

Whether you are looking for a [radiology centre][143] or pathology tests, Vijaya Diagnostic Centre
is the first and ultimate choice. Our vision and reputation have made us the leading name in the
medical sector.

As one of the best [diagnostic centres][144], Vijaya offers world-class support and advanced care,
which can help clinicians diagnose the exact medical issue you are experiencing.

Get in touch with us for the best diagnostic support delivered with professionalism, care, and
empathy.
